LESSON PLAN HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
 Week: Lesson:
 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: SAFETY EDUCATION
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: Waste disposal in the classroom
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to:-
 a. Identify types of waste found in the classroom.
 b. Identify containers used for putting waste in the classroom.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 What waste is found in the classroom?
 Where do we put waste in the classroom?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
 Critical thinking  Responsibility  Health issues
 Communication and  Love  Environmental issues
 collaboration  Respect
  Digital literacy  Citizenship
  Self-efficacy
LEARNING RESOURCES
Picture of different kinds of dusts bins.
Colours, crayons or felt pens.
Focus on Hygiene and nutrition Grade 2 learners’ workbook pg. 57-59.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Review the previous lesson.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Guide the learners on the picture of a classroom shown on page 57 of the learner’s book.
 Step 2: Learners to study the picture and answer the questions provided on the same page of the learner’s
 workbook. The class in not clean.
 Step 3: Allow the learners to identify the waste they can see in the classroom and what waste is and how it
 should be disposed of.
 Step 4: Learners to look around their own class and see whether the waste is disposed of properly.
SUMMARY
Review the lesson
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Unhealthy classroom attracts disease causing germs and pests.
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to appreciate appropriate waste disposal.
REFLECTION ON THE LESSON/SELF-REMARKS

Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to identify common accidents in the classroom.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 What are the common accidents in the classroom?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
 Critical thinking  Responsibility  Health issues
 Communication and  Love  Environmental issues
 collaboration  Respect
  Digital literacy  Citizenship
  Self-efficacy
LEARNING RESOURCES
Picture of bumps, pricks and grazes.
Computer and internet.
First aid box.
Video showing First Aid Treatment.
Focus on Hygiene and nutrition Grade 2 learners’ workbook pg. 60-66.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Review the previous lesson.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Guide the learners on the picture of Sarah tripping over a school bag on learner’s book page 60.
 Step 2: Learners to discuss what they think caused Sara to fall and what else in their environment can cause
 one to trip and fall
 Step 3: Learners to identify the common causes of accidents in their classroom
SUMMARY
Review the lesson
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
It is important to keep classroom safe and free from accidents.
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to appreciate and discuss the hazards that can cause accidents in the classroom.
